purpose: Bounded opportunity inventory for GrantDeskHQ's post-award reporting content. Scores are editorial prioritization factors, not search-volume, traffic, or ranking measurements.

publication.reason: Initial engine setup does not publish pages; a later explicitly queued task must pass all quality gates.

opportunities.search_intent: Operational checklist for organizing a funder report after an award.
opportunities.coverage: Core checklist with agreement, financial, evidence, and review guidance.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Remain the sole general post-award reporting checklist; link to the more specific agreement, budget, progress, and closeout guides.

opportunities.search_intent: Finance workflow for mapping accounting data to a grant budget and reviewing variances.
opportunities.coverage: Budget mapping, variance evidence, and closeout trail.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Do not broaden into an unreviewed template or duplicate the finance pillar candidate.

opportunities.search_intent: Set up a reporting plan from an executed award agreement.
opportunities.coverage: Obligations, owners, workback planning, and source-linked review.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Keep agreement interpretation distinct from the general checklist and progress-report workflow.

opportunities.search_intent: Prepare a recurring grant progress report with finance, program, and review inputs.
opportunities.coverage: Period controls, financial summary, program evidence, and human review.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Keep recurring-progress intent separate from closeout and agreement setup.

opportunities.search_intent: Organize final grant reporting and evidence at closeout.
opportunities.coverage: Closeout terms, financial reconciliation, evidence package, and review.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Retain the closeout-only scope; do not duplicate recurring reporting guidance.

opportunities.search_intent: Evaluate software for a nonprofit's post-award reporting workflow.
opportunities.coverage: Buyer guidance that distinguishes post-award reporting from discovery, proposals, CRM, and accounting.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Do not make competitor or alternative claims without a separately approved current-fact review.

opportunities.search_intent: Checklist for supporting documentation in a grant report.
opportunities.coverage: No live page; candidate must provide an original usable artifact and factual sources.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Must complement, not repackage, the reporting checklist or progress workflow.

opportunities.search_intent: Plan grant-reporting deadlines from award-specific terms.
opportunities.coverage: No live page; candidate requires a substantive controlled planning resource.
opportunities.overlap_guard: Do not overlap the agreement-to-plan guide without a distinct, usable calendar asset.
